migration_flags.description: user_type_id Many2One to account.account.type was removed in v17. account_type is now a direct selection field on account.account with 19 values. No intermediate account type model exists in v19.
migration_flags.action: Remove any reference to user_type_id; map to account_type selection value directly.

migration_flags.description: company_id Many2One was replaced by company_ids Many2Many in v17. One account record can now belong to multiple companies (shared COA). asset_cash type accounts are blocked from multi-company sharing.
migration_flags.action: Migrate company_id=X to company_ids=[(6,0,[X])]. Check for cash accounts; ensure they remain single-company.

migration_flags.description: The deprecated boolean field was removed in v17+. Active=False is the v19 way to archive/deprecate an account. Line 1075 contains a legacy write-guard referencing 'deprecated' but no such field is formally defined in v19.
migration_flags.action: Map deprecated=True -> active=False. Remove any deprecated field references from migration scripts.

migration_flags.description: code is now a computed field backed by code_store which is company_dependent=True (JSONB per root company). Accounts can have different codes per company. Code uniqueness is enforced across parent/child company hierarchy.
migration_flags.action: Ensure migration preserves per-company codes via code_mapping_ids or code_store JSONB. Do not treat code as a simple varchar.

migration_flags.description: Bank and cash accounts (account_type=asset_cash) cannot be shared between companies. Constraint _check_company_consistency at line 280 raises ValidationError if attempted.
migration_flags.action: Ensure each bank/cash account is assigned to exactly one company in company_ids.

migration_flags.description: reconcile is precomputed from account_type. asset_receivable and liability_payable are forced reconcile=True. off_balance, income, expense, equity, asset_cash, liability_credit_card are forced reconcile=False. Other asset/liability types are user-controlled.
migration_flags.action: Do not hardcode reconcile on import for auto-managed types; let the compute run.

migration_flags.description: opening_debit and opening_credit use a precommit batch callback for bulk import. Direct writes to these computed fields are staged and applied together at end of transaction.
migration_flags.action: Use the inverse fields (opening_debit/opening_credit) for import; do not write directly to journal items.

key_findings.company_relationship: Many2Many (company_ids) — shared COA across company hierarchy
key_findings.deprecated_field_status: REMOVED in v17; replaced by active=False; legacy check at line 1075 is dead code
key_findings.user_type_id_status: REMOVED in v17; direct selection replaces M2O to account.account.type
key_findings.name_search_behavior: Filters by move_type context; suggests partner-frequent accounts; digit-in-term bypasses type filter
key_findings.group_id_mechanism: SQL prefix-range match against account.group; longest match wins; non-stored computed
